messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: p99 streaming tail latency spike detected for /v1/stream (region: us-east-1). paging on-call (severity: sev2). Auto-runbooks triggered.

marta: I’m on it — looking at console metrics now. p95 up ~600ms -> 1.6s, p99 at 6.2s. Noted increases across multiple hosts.

alex_m: saw multiple clients report chunking stalls, SSE keepalive gaps. Any customer-impact reports? @cs-eng fyi.

cs-eng: getting 2 customer escalations (enterprise). They see partial streams then silence, reconnects. No data loss reported yet, but UX is bad.

kiran: checking proxy logs for 504s/timeouts. hitrate on edge nodes spiked at 11:34:12 UTC. Might be connection writeback stalls.

oncall-sre: I’m joining, will triage on-call for 15m. What’s the affected model / route?

marta: /v1/stream endpoints for text-generation (multi-tenant). Route weight 80% to latest-small model; fallback variants available.

edge-proxy-bot: Alert: ALB 5xx ratio increased to 3.1% in us-east-1 (5m). Top upstream error: EPIPE while writing to client.

kiran: EPIPE suggests slow consumers triggering socket backpressure; proxy write buffer stuck. Also seeing keepalive timers reset frequently: 
```
tcp_last_ack: 0 \nconn_write_queue_ms: 2300\n
```

alex_m: Any recent deploys to streaming runtime?

marta: No inbound deploys in last 2 hours. Autoscaler scaled serving pool at 11:28 from 24 -> 30 nodes. CPU is fine; per-host net_io_tx spiked.

oncall-sre: Can we repro locally with a slow consumer? I’ll spin up a client that reads slowly to test proxy backpressure behaviour.

kiran: Meanwhile, suggest temporary mitigation: increase proxy write timeout and reduce per-connection chunk buffer to avoid head-of-line blocking, and add circuit to drop stalled connections after N seconds. If we do that, customers might see truncated streams but less widespread stalls. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

alex_m: +1 to safer timeouts. Also enable fallback: non-streaming chunked poll endpoints for enterprise customers until resolved.

cs-eng: Enterprise customers prefer truncated but functional over complete stall. We'll coordinate messaging.

marta: I’m going to roll a config change to edge proxy for us-east-1: set keepalive_timeout from 90s -> 30s, write_timeout from 10s -> 6s, and enable connection-dropping for stalled writes > 8s. Rolling 10% canary now.

edge-proxy-bot: Canaries deployed to 3/30 edge nodes in us-east-1 at 11:44:02 UTC. Observability: watch 5xx & p99.

kiran: While canary is rolling, I’ll enable extra logging for socket states (non-blocking counters) and KV client write latency.

noncall-sre: Repro report: with slow-reader (read chunk every 4s) proxy nodes without new config accumulate write queues causing all streams on that connection to stall. This matches customer reports.

marta: Canary looks promising: p99 on canary nodes dropped to 1.2s within 90s. Non-canary still elevated. Proceed with region-wide rollout?

alex_m: Approve. Do it gradually 20% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m watch windows. Keep rollback plan ready.

marta: Rolling to 50% now.

edge-proxy-bot: Rollout at 11:51 -> 50% complete. No regressions on canary metrics.

kiran: I spotted a correlated spike in long-lived Open connections on one upstream serving host (svc-gen-17). Pulling thread dump for runtime.

noncall-sre: Runtime thread dump shows stalled write worker threads blocked on kernel socket buffer when clients stop reading. We need better write-side backpressure handling in the runtime.

marta: Short-term mitigation is the proxy config change; longer-term: patch runtime to limit per-connection output queue and drop oldest prefixes when buffer is full. Create ticket?

alex_m: Filing ticket with priority P1 to eng-runtime: limit-output-queue and backpressure-handling. Assign to @kiran.

kiran: Got it — will scope and start on a hotfix branch after this incident stabilizes.

cs-eng: Customer comms: sending interim note that we’ve applied a streaming proxy fix and will follow up. They appreciate the quick update.

marta: Rollout to 100% complete at 11:58. Edge-proxy metrics: overall p99 dropped from 6.2s -> 1.1s across us-east-1 over 4m. 5xx briefly spiked during rollout to 0.9% then fell.

edge-proxy-bot: ALB 5xx ratio now 0.4%. Conn write queue median down to 120ms.

noncall-sre: Observed immediate reduction in stalled connections. Some customers had partial streams; CS is following up to validate UX.

marta: Marking mitigation as applied. Next steps: (1) eng-runtime P1 ticket (2) add e2e slow-consumer test in staging harness (3) consider adaptive chunk pacing and server-driven keepalive frames.

alex_m: Also recommend adding an automated fallback route: if streaming handshake sees repeated write stalls, serve a poll endpoint link in the initial response JSON. Make that a config flag.

kiran: I'll include a safe fallback in the runtime patch.

cs-eng: Customers confirm improvement. One enterprise reported some missing trailing tokens in long outputs, but functional.

marta: Closing the live mitigation. Keeping on-call for monitoring for next 60m. Incident status -> mitigated (not fully resolved). Filing incident follow-up with timeline and RCA.

incident-bot: Incident updated: severity downgraded to sev3 (mitigated). Follow-up RCA scheduled.

oncall-sre: Quick notes for handoff: metrics to watch: p95/p99 streaming latency, ALB 5xx ratio, conn_write_queue_ms, runtime write-thread-blocked_count. Paging policy: page on sustained p99 > 3s for >5m.

marta: Thanks all. Good coordination. cc @cs-eng for customer postmortem comms. :thumbsup:

cs-eng: Will draft customer postmortem and let you review.

alex_m: Closing thread, will add timeline to postmortem doc.
